company.description: Increase is API-first banking helping teams build the best financial products with speed, precision, and control. Increase has offered banking infrastructure since 2020, and we introduced Increase Bank in 2026.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $34,797,337 to $34,797,337, a 1x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 90 (+8 over 90 days) and market heat at 87 (+8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
